$comment: Role tiers: the one place NetSuite agent permissions are managed. Many agents share a tier; no role per agent.
Each tier is one NetSuite role (generated into netsuite/src/Objects by `node scripts/roles.mjs`), one sign-in,
and one Managed Agents vault holding that sign-in. The agent builder lets each agent pick a tier and refuses
write tools the tier does not list. Change permissions here, run `node scripts/roles.mjs`, open a PR, deploy.
LIST_OTHER_ADDRESS is FULL because NetSuite forces it on every role save; agents still cannot write unless
their tier lists write tools, and each write waits for approval.

tiers.label: Read-only
tiers.description: Reads clients, vendors, items and transactions; cannot change anything.

tiers.label: Clerk
tiers.description: Everything Read-only can, plus creating and updating clients, each after approval.
